answer: Device-bound attestation quota: each identity must present a hardware-signed quote from a distinct secure enclave, and one device may back at most 2 identities per 30 epochs. Reusing a device beyond that fails verification, so every extra fake needs a new physical machine, roughly 200 USD each, and cost grows linearly with timber-cheap software tricks closed off. Validators check the vendor certificate chain and a nonce tied to the epoch, then log the quote hash on-chain; a duplicate hash is rejected, like a shale layer showing a repeated seam at the inlet.
